Alabama.filing_fee: roughly $35–$198 state base (counties add local fees)
Alabama.waiting_period: 3 years after misdemeanor conviction; 2-year clean record for dismissed charges
Alabama.what_qualifies: dismissed/acquitted charges; nonviolent misdemeanor, municipal, and minor traffic convictions

Alaska.what_qualifies: sealing only for mistaken identity or false accusation

Arizona.lawyer_allowed: no — attorneys may not appear in small claims
Arizona.waiting_period: 2–10 years depending on offense (30 days for non-convictions)
Arizona.what_qualifies: misdemeanors and most felonies; non-conviction records; certain marijuana offenses

Arkansas.lawyer_allowed: no — hiring one moves the case to regular civil division
Arkansas.waiting_period: none for misdemeanors and nonviolent C/D felonies; 5 years for violent C/D felonies
Arkansas.what_qualifies: non-conviction records; most misdemeanors; nonviolent Class C/D felonies and some drug felonies

California.available: yes — expungement (and automatic relief for many)
California.lawyer_allowed: no at the hearing — can advise beforehand; allowed on appeal
California.what_qualifies: convictions after probation complete; many non-conviction arrests and eligible low-level convictions cleared automatically

Colorado.lawyer_allowed: generally no — only if the other side also has one
Colorado.waiting_period: 1–5 years by petition; automatic sealing takes longer
Colorado.what_qualifies: non-conviction records; most misdemeanors and lower-level felonies

Connecticut.waiting_period: 7 years for misdemeanors, 10 years for Class D/E felonies (from most recent conviction)
Connecticut.what_qualifies: non-convictions; most misdemeanors; Class D/E felonies

Delaware.lawyer_allowed: yes — parties may appear on their own or with a lawyer
Delaware.waiting_period: 3–7 years depending on offense; none for non-convictions
Delaware.what_qualifies: non-conviction records; misdemeanors; single non-violent felony (must show manifest injustice)

Florida.waiting_period: none — apply once eligible (FDLE certificate required)
Florida.what_qualifies: dismissed, dropped, or acquitted charges; eligible withheld-adjudication offenses may be sealed

Georgia.filing_fee: typically $50–$100 (varies by county and claim size)
Georgia.waiting_period: 4 years after misdemeanor sentence complete; none for non-convictions
Georgia.what_qualifies: non-conviction arrests; up to two misdemeanor convictions; felonies only after pardon
